changeSet.author: gregory bliault
changeSet.sql: WITH ranked AS ( SELECT id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY fk_person, fk_institution, split_part(view_key, ':', 2) ORDER BY updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC) AS rank FROM public.user_view_state WHERE view_key ~ '^detail:[^:]+:.+$' ) UPDATE public.user_view_state s SET view_key = 'detail:' || split_part(s.view_key, ':', 2) FROM ranked r WHERE r.id = s.id AND r.rank = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.user_view_state t WHERE t.fk_person = s.fk_person AND t.fk_institution = s.fk_institution AND t.view_key = 'detail:' || split_part(s.view_key, ':', 2));
